name: Double Ratio Spread (Short / Naked)
summary: The inverse of the double backspread - buy 1 nearer-the-money option and sell 2 further-OTM options on both the call and put side; collects large premium with uncovered tails. Requires level 4 and is outside this system's risk policy.

legs.strike_rule: 0.15-0.20 delta put (further OTM, UNCOVERED beyond the 1:1 pair)
0.15-0.20 delta call (further OTM, UNCOVERED beyond the 1:1 pair)

max_profit: net credit plus the width between the long and short strikes on whichever side finishes at the short strike, x 100
max_loss: UNDEFINED - one extra naked short call (unlimited upside loss) and one extra naked short put (loss down to zero) per unit
breakevens: two breakevens outside the short strikes; compute numerically at entry
when_to_use: Never on this account. Level 3 forbids uncovered short calls and puts, and Alpaca will reject the order. Listed for completeness and so the screener can recognize and block the shape.
entry_rules: PROHIBITED at Alpaca options level 3 - the second short on each side is uncovered. Requires level 4.
Order-validation rule for the system: reject any proposed structure where the count of short contracts of a given right exceeds the count of long contracts of that right at a protective strike
If it were ever run at level 4: naked short notional per unit <= 5% of equity, and a hard stop at 2x credit
management_rules: Not applicable - blocked at the order-validation layer
exit_rules: If somehow held: close the uncovered shorts first, then the longs, same session
Standard guards on every short: close if extrinsic < $0.10 or |delta| >= 0.85
assignment_risk: Unbounded. Each unit carries one uncovered short call (assignment creates 100 short shares with unlimited loss) and one uncovered short put (assignment creates a 100-share purchase obligation with no offsetting long).
buying_power: Naked margin: roughly 20% of underlying notional minus the OTM amount per uncovered short, per contract.
common_mistakes: Confusing it with the backspread (which has the shorts closer to the money and is defined risk); assuming the 1 long per side covers 2 shorts.
zero_dte_notes: No - uncovered 0DTE shorts are the fastest path to an unrecoverable loss.
family: four-leg structures (iron condors, iron butterflies, condors, double calendars/diagonals, boxes, jelly rolls, conversions/reversals, double verticals, double ratio spreads)
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
